accelerator_bound.arm_mix_note: 0.52 = one Solver contact in lock-row equivalents, solver / (perception + solver) node seconds of scripts/flights/nx/l338_cost_inputs.json; a direct-only contact carries no knowledge, so the prefill side is an over-estimate and the reasoning length is not; the smoke measures the real mix
accelerator_bound.caps_note: generation = rows x (1 contact + 1 answer-only fallback), FIT = rows x 1 x 1 counting endpoint (core.preparation_fit.direct_only_fit_contact_cap, the value build_direct_only_raw_fit_gate demands), audio = ceil(roster speech-seconds x the generation contacts per row). The ceiling per Fold B row is 2 contacts per pass with the fallback re-ask; the plan's '2 per row' counts the twin only, so the cell makes 3 programme contacts per Fold B row over its three passes.

formula.aa: PROVISIONAL NPU card-hours of ONE pass = ceil_0.1(1.3 x 1,080 rows x 0.52 lock-row equivalents x T / r / 60), T = tensor-parallel size (cards per instance), r = the measured lock-only rows per minute of ONE instance at its chosen sequences per instance; the instance count cancels (wall-clock = card-hours / (instances x T)); T and r from PORT_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE (pending; filled from the measured speed sweep); three passes in the cell
formula.ab: PROVISIONAL NPU card-hours of ONE pass = ceil_0.1(1.3 x 1,080 rows x 0.52 lock-row equivalents x T / r / 60), T = tensor-parallel size (cards per instance), r = the measured lock-only rows per minute of ONE instance at its chosen sequences per instance; the instance count cancels (wall-clock = card-hours / (instances x T)); T and r from PORT_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE (pending; filled from the measured speed sweep); three passes in the cell
formula.lock: PROVISIONAL NPU card-hours of ONE pass = ceil_0.1(1.3 x 1,080 rows x 0.52 lock-row equivalents x T / r / 60), T = tensor-parallel size (cards per instance), r = the measured lock-only rows per minute of ONE instance at its chosen sequences per instance; the instance count cancels (wall-clock = card-hours / (instances x T)); T and r from PORT_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE (pending; filled from the measured speed sweep); three passes in the cell
formula.smoke: PROVISIONAL NPU card-hours = 0.5 h wall-clock allowance x instances x T (every held card), from PORT_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE (pending; filled from the measured speed sweep)

prohibitions: No system-level, superiority, generalisation or admission claim from this read; the Thinking model is admitted ONLY for this read.
No reasoning text delivered, persisted (beyond hashes) or scored; preserve_wire_responses stays false on every cell.
No pass before the four-row smoke has sealed and the machine sign-off conditions hold.

No deployment value (instances, tensor-parallel size, sequences per instance, devices) is registered here; the cell is not flown before PORT_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE is filled from the measured sweep and the card-hour bound re-derived.
No test-split, Fold A or DEV contact; no flight before root countersigns the DRAFT rows, the receipt is minted and the cells are flipped; --allow-output-change is never passed.

read_rule.a_to_d_gap: A-to-D is a cross-run, cross-program comparison read at the cross-run bar of 2.5 pp; the expected gap is about 26 pp, so the bar does not bind
read_rule.analysis_recipe: not part of this package: the D reader and its recipe are an open item; this block is the rule it must implement

bootstrap.note: the 266-E values unless the T2 recipe for D fixes others

read_rule.claim_boundary: No system-level, superiority, generalisation, test or confirmatory claim; a development-fold capability read of the bare core.
read_rule.kind: PREREGISTERED reading of arm D; development numbers only
read_rule.primary: official SLURP pooled SLU-F1 (micro; scorer slurp-slu-official-train, the pinned official evaluate.py), natural-mixture weighting, with intent accuracy (scenario_action_exact) beside it; the per-row F1 is a repo diagnostic reported beside the pooled F1, never an official SLURP number

replicates.note: lock is the delivering pass; aa and ab are request-identical replicates in the same chain (noise model M1: separate runs, not the in-flight twin, because the direct-only program has no arm table). Same-chain replicates also absorb session drift, so they measure at least the within-run decoding term.

read_rule.truncation: A cap-hit row is sealed as a receipted empty answer (saea-empty-completion-v1 and saea-thinking-answer-fallback-v1) and scored as such; never re-asked beyond the one registered answer-only fallback (266-E preregistration section 3; decision 199). The M4 trace logs the truncation flag per contact.
read_rule.twin_admissibility: |SLU-F1(aa) - SLU-F1(lock)| <= 1.2 pp (the port analysis recipe's twin rule)
